sourceDatasetId.title: Source dataset ID
sourceDatasetId.description: Dataset ID produced by the facebook-pages-scraper run.

airtable.title: Airtable
airtable.description: Configuration of your Airtable base and target tables.

runTable.title: Run Log table name
runTable.description: Table name that stores one record per scraper run.

profileTable.title: Master Profile List table name
profileTable.description: Table name that stores deduplicated Facebook profiles.

profileKeyFieldName.title: Profile merge key field (Airtable)
profileKeyFieldName.description: Airtable field used as the upsert/merge key (e.g., 'Facebook ID').

linkFieldName.title: Link field (Master to Run Log)
linkFieldName.description: Linked-record field on Master Profile List that links to Run Log (must allow multiple).

statusFieldName.title: Status field name
statusFieldName.description: Single-select field on Master Profile List to track profile processing state.

statusComplete.title: Status label for completed scrape
statusComplete.description: Exact single-select option to set on successful profile upsert.

runInfo.title: Run info (from scraper)
runInfo.description: Metadata for the scraper run used to find the Run Log record for linking.

runId.title: Scraper Run ID
runId.description: The Apify run ID of the facebook-pages-scraper run that produced this dataset.

actorName.title: Actor name
actorName.description: Optional; name of the actor that produced the dataset.

finishedAt.title: Finished at
finishedAt.description: Optional; ISO datetime when the scraper run finished.

urlsFound.title: URLs found
urlsFound.description: Optional; count of dataset items, for logging only.

params.title: Run parameters
params.description: Optional; input JSON of the scraper run (stored for audit).

maxItems.title: Max items to process (optional)
maxItems.description: Process at most this many items from the dataset (useful for smoke tests).
